title: Dogfood skill_source=plugin: opt this repo in and delete its own SKILL.md
description: Per opum-agent OPAG-41's ruling on LCLI-443: flip this repository's own .lore/config.toml to [agents] skill_source = "plugin" and delete .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md through the path LCLI-443 built (lore agents --check goes red/orphaned, lore agents --force removes the byte-exact file, lore agents --check goes green). This is the first real use of the feature, the deletion this repository owes since the opum-lore plugin (LCLI-441) already ships the same skill, and it removes the duplicate .claude/skills/lore copy from the plugin's own packaged cache at the next release (half of LCLI-441's packaging hygiene item).

acceptanceCriteria.text: [agents].skill_source = "plugin" is persisted in this repository's own .lore/config.toml
lore agents --check reports .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md orphaned and exits 6 before removal
lore agents --force removes the file (byte-exact match, action removed) and a subsequent lore agents --check exits 0

finalSummary: Flipped this repository's own .lore/config.toml to [agents] skill_source = "plugin" via lore init --skill-source plugin (the real supported path, not a hand-edit), then walked the full lifecycle live: lore agents --check reported .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md orphaned and exited 6; lore agents --force removed it (byte-exact match, action removed); lore agents --check then exited 0. Documented the override in .lore/config.toml's own header comment, matching its existing Backlog-to-Quest cutover note. Dogfooding surfaced a real gap in LCLI-443: buildNudgeBody() (src/core/agent-bridge.ts) always pointed CLAUDE.md's managed nudge at the per-repo SKILL.md path regardless of skill_source, so after the file's removal the nudge pointed at a path that must not exist. Fixed by threading skillSource into buildNudgeBody/planNudge -- under "plugin" the nudge's Skill line now names the opum-lore marketplace plugin instead of a path. Added 2 new tests pinning this (unit-level buildNudgeBody("plugin") and an end-to-end lore agents run asserting CLAUDE.md contains no stale path and does name opum-lore). Updated docs/reference/lore-cli-repository-notes.md's project-level-skills inventory (now one skill, not two) and docs/reference/cli-surface.md's init/agents sections (the new --skill-source flag, the orphaned/removed actions, exit-6 case) since both described this repo's own current state. Fixed test/config.test.ts's self-hosting regression test that pins this repo's own config against defaults plus its documented overrides -- it now expects both the tracker=quest and agents.skillSource=plugin overrides. Full suite 2839 pass/1 skip/0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean (one pre-existing unrelated warning), lore check 77 files/0 errors.
